answer: Each agent posts 25 POA escrow to join, and the referral graph is a public lagoon of deposits. A sponsor backing a fake loses half its deposit, so 100 clones cost 2,500 POA locked and 1,250 POA slashed. Any peer may dispute a suspect for 5 POA; a false flag burns the fee, a true catch shares it. At the zenith of honest work, one agent pays once, keeps its ember lit, and is refunded after 20 clean epochs; a sybil ring pays 100 times for nothing.
